resources.name: Scrap Metal
resources.description: Salvaged metal from the constant construction and destruction on Nar Shaddaa. Valuable for crafting and repairs.

resources.name: Electronics Components
resources.description: Salvaged electronics and circuit boards from the moon's extensive technology infrastructure.

resources.name: Hidden Credits
resources.description: Stashes of credits hidden by smugglers, criminals, or those who met untimely ends. Finding one is like winning the lottery.

resources.name: Spice Sample
resources.description: Small amounts of spice left behind in the lower levels. Illegal to possess, but valuable on the black market.

resources.name: Weapon Components
resources.description: Parts and components from weapons that have seen use in the moon's constant conflicts.

resources.name: Data Chips
resources.description: Information storage devices containing everything from trade routes to blackmail material. Information is power on Nar Shaddaa.
